items.title: S-derivations of a module sheaf on an affine scheme correspond to R-derivations of its module of global sections
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The statement is a bijection between the S-derivations of a sheaf of O_X-modules on X = Spec(A) and the R-derivations of the module of global sections, for a ring map R to A with S = Spec(R) (statement lines 6408-6417). The counted proof has real content in two places: uniqueness comes from writing a section over a standard open as a/f^n and solving the Leibniz identity for D(a/f^n), using that f acts invertibly on the sections of F over that open (proof lines 6419-6427), and existence is obtained by displaying the value of the derivation explicitly and checking the axioms on a basis of standard opens (proof lines 6428-6433). It is H2: the argument is a local computation on one affine chart rather than a reduction to a cited theorem, but it uses no hypothesis beyond the affine situation, so no H3 claim is made.
